references.actually_read: Visible complete1-1,1-2 and1-5, plus visible radiation discussion in1-4. Tool output truncated in parts of1-3/1-4; those omitted portions are not evidence.
references.evidence: Fields are physical quantities assigned to positions and times, not a required mechanical material filling space. Static Coulomb force is simple, while moving-source interactions involve time delays and acceleration. Electromagnetic fields can propagate through space without intermediate material charges or currents. Macroscopic contact forces involve microscopic electrical and quantum effects.
references.limits: No numerical constant, additional formula, exclusive historical priority or universal quantum-theory interpretation is imported. Air/sound remains a mechanical-medium example, not proof that electromagnetic propagation requires air.
